title: Supply of Industrial Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and Safety Gear

requirements.title: PAN Card Verification
requirements.description: Bidder must submit a valid Permanent Account Number (PAN) issued by the Income Tax Department, matching the legal entity name on the bid.

requirements.title: GST Registration & Active Filing Status
requirements.description: Bidder must hold a valid GSTIN with 'Active' filing status for at least the preceding 6 months, verified against GSTN records.

requirements.title: MSME/Udyam Registration (Optional Preference)
requirements.description: Bidders registered as Micro or Small Enterprises under Udyam may claim purchase preference under the Public Procurement Policy for MSEs 2012. Not mandatory for eligibility.

requirements.title: BIS/ISI Certification for Safety Gear
requirements.description: All supplied PPE items (helmets, safety shoes, gloves, etc.) must carry valid BIS/ISI certification marks as applicable to the product category.

requirements.title: OEM Authorization Letter
requirements.description: If the bidder is not the manufacturer, a letter from the Original Equipment Manufacturer authorizing the bidder as a dealer/distributor is required.

requirements.title: Make in India / Local Content Certificate
requirements.description: Bidder must submit self-certification of local content percentage per the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017.
requirements.threshold_value: >=50% local content for Class-I supplier status

requirements.title: Non-Blacklisting / Debarment Declaration
requirements.description: Bidder must not be under any active blacklisting or debarment order from CPCL, MoPNG, or any Central/State Government procuring entity.

requirements.title: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) / Bid Security
requirements.description: Bidder must furnish EMD as specified, unless exempted under MSE/Udyam or Startup India provisions.

requirements.title: Past Supply Experience Certificate
requirements.description: Bidder must demonstrate at least one similar completed supply order of comparable value in the preceding 3 years, supported by a client-issued completion certificate.
requirements.threshold_value: 1 order, last 3 years, >=40% of tender value

requirements.title: Minimum Annual Turnover
requirements.description: Bidder must submit audited financial statements or a CA certificate showing minimum average annual turnover over the last 3 financial years.

title: Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for Plant Fire & Safety Systems

requirements.title: PAN Card Verification
requirements.description: Bidder must submit a valid PAN matching the legal entity name on the bid.

requirements.title: GST Registration & Active Filing Status
requirements.description: Bidder must hold a valid GSTIN with 'Active' filing status for at least the preceding 6 months.

requirements.title: MSME/Udyam Registration (Optional Preference)
requirements.description: Udyam-registered Micro/Small service providers may claim purchase preference. Not mandatory for eligibility.

requirements.title: Past AMC/Service Experience
requirements.description: Bidder must have satisfactorily executed at least 2 similar AMC/service contracts of comparable scope in the last 3 years, each valued at not less than 40% of the estimated contract value, supported by client completion certificates.

requirements.title: Technical Manpower Deployment Plan
requirements.description: Bidder must submit a manpower deployment plan listing qualified technicians/engineers to be deployed on-site, with relevant certifications.
requirements.threshold_value: Min. 1 certified fire & safety technician on-site

requirements.title: EPFO & ESIC Registration
requirements.description: Bidder must hold valid EPFO and ESIC registration, as the contract involves deployment of contract labour on CPCL premises.

requirements.title: Service Level Agreement / Response Time Commitment
requirements.description: Bidder must accept the SLA clause committing to a maximum breakdown response time and a specified uptime percentage for maintained equipment.

requirements.title: Non-Blacklisting / Debarment Declaration
requirements.description: Bidder must not be under any active blacklisting or debarment order from CPCL, MoPNG, or any Central/State Government procuring entity.

requirements.title: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) / Bid Security
requirements.description: Bidder must furnish EMD as specified, unless exempted under MSE/Udyam or Startup India provisions.

requirements.title: Minimum Annual Turnover
requirements.description: Bidder must submit audited financials showing minimum average annual turnover over the last 3 financial years.

title: Procurement of Industrial Spares under MSE Purchase Preference Policy

requirements.title: PAN Card Verification
requirements.description: Bidder must submit a valid PAN matching the legal entity name on the bid.

requirements.title: GST Registration & Active Filing Status
requirements.description: Bidder must hold a valid GSTIN with 'Active' filing status for at least the preceding 6 months.

requirements.title: Udyam Registration (Mandatory)
requirements.description: This tender is preferenced under the Public Procurement Policy for Micro & Small Enterprises 2012. Bidder must hold a valid Udyam Registration Certificate classifying it as Micro or Small.

requirements.title: MSE Sub-Category Proof (SC/ST/Women-owned)
requirements.description: Bidders may optionally submit proof of SC/ST-owned or women-owned enterprise status to claim sub-target reservation under the MSE Policy.

requirements.title: EMD Exemption for Udyam-Registered Bidders
requirements.description: Udyam-registered Micro/Small bidders are exempt from furnishing EMD; non-MSE bidders must submit standard EMD.

requirements.title: Purchase Preference at L1 Price Declaration
requirements.description: Eligible MSE bidders quoting within 15% of the L1 price may be given an opportunity to match L1 and receive a share of the order, per the Purchase Preference Policy.

requirements.title: Non-Blacklisting / Debarment Declaration
requirements.description: Bidder must not be under any active blacklisting or debarment order from CPCL, MoPNG, or any Central/State Government procuring entity.

requirements.title: Past Supply Experience (Relaxed for MSE)
requirements.description: Experience criteria are relaxed for Udyam-registered MSE bidders per government policy; non-MSE bidders must meet the full standard criterion of at least 1 similar completed order in the last 3 years.
requirements.threshold_value: Relaxed for MSE; standard: 1 order in last 3 years

requirements.title: Minimum Annual Turnover (Relaxed for MSE)
requirements.description: Turnover criteria may be relaxed up to 100% for Udyam-registered MSE bidders per policy; the standard threshold otherwise applies.

requirements.title: Quality Certification (ISO/BIS as applicable)
requirements.description: Where applicable to the item category, bidder may submit ISO 9001 or BIS certification to strengthen quality compliance evidence.
